archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / MODERN SAAS (Clean, Vibrant & High-Contrast Precision)
design_philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King. Hybrid split workspace with live LinkedIn feed simulation, high-density actionable tools, subtle ambient mesh gradients, and pixel-perfect interactive feedback.

user_choices.design_theme: Premium Modern SaaS with clean white background, soft subtle violet-blue ambient gradients (#FAF8FF to #F4F7FF), crisp border outlines, and rich contrast elements
user_choices.typography_style: Clean, authoritative Sans paired with high-impact Display headings
user_choices.workspace_layout: Dedicated Dual-Pane Generator & Live LinkedIn Feed Preview Editor with Dashboard Management & Drafts Kanban/List
user_choices.data_persistence: MongoDB backed with anonymous-session fallback via localStorage/session tokens

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

visual_enhancers.badge_style: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border border-indigo-200/60

navigation_header.description: Sticky top bar with blurred white background, PostCraft AI logo with violet icon badge, active route navigation, quick action ('New Post'), session draft count badge, and setting trigger.

hero_banner.description: Compact high-converting header showcasing platform value proposition, AI badge, model selector (Gemini 3 Flash), and quick start templates.

generator_panel.description: Form with Topic/Idea input textarea, Category selector (Personal Branding, Career Updates, Educational, Storytelling, Tech, Business, Project Showcase, Motivation), Tone, Length, Language (English, Hindi, Hinglish), Target Audience, Keywords, and CTA fields.

editor_preview_workspace.description: Split tab or side-by-side workspace: Left pane features direct rich draft editor & AI toolbar (Regenerate, Rewrite, Shorten, Expand, Improve Hook, Fix Grammar, Add Hashtags, Quality Audit); Right pane features realistic LinkedIn Feed simulator complete with creator profile header, 'see more' cutoff line, reaction count mock, copy/download actions.

ai_quick_tools.description: Action bar with instant refinement buttons: 'Fix Grammar', 'Viral Hook', 'Shorten', 'Expand', 'Generate Hashtags', 'Quality Score Audit'.

drafts_dashboard.description: Searchable, filterable list/grid of saved drafts with category tags, engagement preview score, session indicator, edit, duplicate, and delete controls.

image_urls.description: Creator desk and laptop workspace setup

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete React + Tailwind JS app for PostCraft AI with full AI generation capabilities.
Support Google Gemini 3 Flash via backend API endpoint, with fallback to mock structured responses if backend API key is unset.

Ensure all major interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='generate-post-button', data-testid='post-topic-input', data-testid='post-editor-textarea', data-testid='copy-post-button', data-testid='save-draft-button').
Include a quality/readability audit widget showing PostCraft Hook Score, Readability Rating, and Scannability Index.
Persist user drafts in MongoDB via backend API, fallback to localStorage if network or session requires.
accessibility_and_ux_rules: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for standard body text.
Provide explicit hover and focus states with dark text on light backgrounds and ring outlines.
Add toast notifications (using sonner) for action confirmations (e.g. 'Post copied to clipboard!', 'Draft saved successfully').
Support responsive mobile views with tab toggles between 'Form', 'Editor', and 'LinkedIn Preview'.
